audio.t: May I have your attention, passengers on Horizon Airways flight 62 to Seoul.
Because of heavy fog at the destination, our departure has been postponed by approximately two hours.
Please keep your boarding pass, as the gate may change if the delay continues.
Passengers with connecting flights should see the transfer desk, where agents will reserve new seats for you.
Meal vouchers worth fifteen dollars will be available at the information counter starting in thirty minutes.
We appreciate your understanding.

questions.q: Why is the flight delayed?
options: The late arrival of the aircraft
questions.explain: Thông báo nói 'Because of heavy fog at the destination'.

questions.q: What are passengers with connecting flights asked to do?
questions.explain: Họ được yêu cầu 'see the transfer desk' để được giữ chỗ mới.

questions.q: What will be available in thirty minutes?
questions.explain: Câu 'Meal vouchers ... will be available ... starting in thirty minutes'.

audio.t: Good morning, this is the Daily Ledger's weekly briefing for our readers.
This Sunday, we're launching a redesigned digital edition that you can read on your phone or tablet.
Current print subscribers will receive free access for six months.
To activate your account, simply visit our Web site and enter the subscriber number printed on your mailing label.
Also, our travel section will now include readers' photographs, so please submit your best vacation pictures by the end of the month.
The winner will be featured on the cover of our August supplement.

questions.q: What is being launched on Sunday?
questions.explain: Người nói nói 'we're launching a redesigned digital edition'.

questions.q: How can listeners activate their accounts?
options: By entering a subscriber number online
questions.explain: Họ cần 'visit our Web site and enter the subscriber number'.

questions.q: What will the contest winner receive?
questions.explain: Người thắng cuộc sẽ 'be featured on the cover' của số phụ trương tháng Tám. Không nhắc tới giải thưởng khác.

audio.t: Looking for fresh, healthy food for your family? Visit Green Valley Farm this weekend.
Our annual harvest festival runs Saturday and Sunday from nine until five.
You can pick your own apples and pumpkins, and every visitor under twelve gets a free cup of hot cider.
We'll also have live music, a petting zoo, and cooking demonstrations using our own organic vegetables.
Admission is free, but parking costs five dollars per vehicle.
For a ten percent discount on any purchase, mention this advertisement at the entrance.

questions.q: What event is being advertised?
questions.explain: Câu 'Our annual harvest festival runs Saturday and Sunday'.

questions.q: What is offered to visitors under twelve?
questions.explain: 'every visitor under twelve gets a free cup of hot cider'. Vào cổng miễn phí cho mọi người nên (A) không đặc biệt cho trẻ em.

questions.q: How can listeners get a discount?
questions.explain: Người nói nói 'mention this advertisement at the entrance' để được giảm 10%.

audio.t: Hello, this is Carla Mendes from Northfield Electric calling for Mr. Ibrahim.
We're scheduled to replace the electricity meter at your property this Thursday between one and three p.m.
The work should take about thirty minutes, and power will be off during that time, so please unplug sensitive equipment such as computers.
Someone over eighteen needs to be at home to let our technician in.
If that time doesn't work, please call us back at 555-0147 before Wednesday noon so we can reschedule.
Thank you.

questions.q: What will be done on Thursday?
options: A new account will be created.
questions.explain: Người nói nói 'We're scheduled to replace the electricity meter ... this Thursday'.

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the listener to do before the work?
questions.explain: Câu 'please unplug sensitive equipment such as computers'.

questions.q: Why might the listener call back?
questions.explain: 'If that time doesn't work, please call us back ... so we can reschedule' tức là gọi lại để đổi lịch hẹn.

audio.t: Attention, shoppers. Welcome to Bright Circuit's anniversary weekend sale.
For the next two hours, all laptops and tablets are marked down by up to thirty percent.
In addition, customers who spend more than two hundred dollars will receive a wireless mouse at no extra cost.
If you'd like help comparing models, our staff members in blue shirts are ready to assist you.
Please note that the sale does not apply to the digital cameras in aisle nine, which are already discounted.
The sale ends at four o'clock, so don't miss out.

questions.q: What is being promoted?
questions.explain: Mở đầu: 'Welcome to Bright Circuit's anniversary weekend sale'.

questions.q: What will customers who spend over two hundred dollars receive?
questions.explain: 'will receive a wireless mouse at no extra cost'.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the cameras?
options: They are not included in the sale.
They are reduced by thirty percent.
questions.explain: 'the sale does not apply to the digital cameras in aisle nine'.

audio.t: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to Coral Bay Resort.
I'm Mina, your activities coordinator, and I'd like to go over a few things for this week.
Tomorrow morning at seven thirty, we'll offer a sunrise yoga session on the east terrace, followed by a healthy breakfast.
On Wednesday, a boat tour of the nearby islands departs from the main dock at ten. Spaces are limited, so please sign up at the front desk by tomorrow evening.
And a quick reminder that the swimming pool will be closed for cleaning on Thursday between noon and three.
If you need anything, just dial zero from your room phone.

questions.q: Who is the speaker?
questions.explain: Cô tự giới thiệu 'I'm Mina, your activities coordinator'.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do by tomorrow evening?
options: Sign up for a boat tour
questions.explain: 'Spaces are limited, so please sign up at the front desk by tomorrow evening' (chuyến đi thuyền).

questions.q: What will happen on Thursday?
options: The pool will be closed for a while.
questions.explain: 'the swimming pool will be closed for cleaning on Thursday between noon and three'.

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone. This is Greg from the human resources department with a few updates.

First, the annual performance reviews will begin on the first of next month. Each of you will receive a self-evaluation form by e-mail this Friday, and it must be returned to your supervisor within one week.
Second, we're introducing a flexible schedule pilot program. Staff in the accounting and design teams may now start work anytime between seven and ten a.m.
If this goes well, we may expand it to other departments after the summer.
Lastly, the company health screening will take place in the main lobby on the fifteenth. Appointments can be made on the staff portal.

questions.q: What will employees receive on Friday?
questions.explain: 'Each of you will receive a self-evaluation form by e-mail this Friday'.

questions.q: Which teams are included in the pilot program?
questions.explain: 'Staff in the accounting and design teams may now start work anytime between seven and ten'. Các phòng khác chỉ có thể được mở rộng sau.

questions.q: How can employees schedule a health screening?
questions.explain: 'Appointments can be made on the staff portal'. Sảnh chính chỉ là nơi diễn ra buổi khám.

audio.t: Welcome to the Old Town walking tour, everyone. My name is Helena, and I'll be your guide today.
We'll begin at the cathedral, which dates back to the twelfth century, and then walk to the central market.
Please note that photography is not allowed inside the cathedral, but you'll have plenty of chances to take pictures at the market.
We'll make a short stop at a bakery, where you can sample local pastries. Anyone with allergies should let me know now.
The tour lasts about two hours, and we'll finish at the riverside park. Please stay close, as the streets are crowded.
Now, if you're ready, let's get started.

questions.q: Where will the tour begin?
questions.explain: 'We'll begin at the cathedral'. Chợ là điểm kế tiếp, công viên là điểm kết thúc.

questions.q: What are listeners told they cannot do?
questions.explain: 'photography is not allowed inside the cathedral'.

questions.q: What are people with allergies asked to do?
questions.explain: 'Anyone with allergies should let me know now', tức là báo cho hướng dẫn viên.

audio.t: Thank you for purchasing the Aura smart thermostat, which can help reduce your energy use by up to fifteen percent.
Before you begin installation, please turn off the power to your heating system at the main circuit breaker.
Remove the old thermostat and label each wire using the stickers included in the box.
Next, connect the wires to the matching terminals on the back plate and attach the new display.
Once the power is turned back on, download the Aura app and follow the instructions to connect the device to your home Wi-Fi.
If you run into trouble, our support team is available twenty-four hours a day at the number on the back of the manual.

questions.q: What is a benefit of the product?
questions.explain: 'can help reduce your energy use by up to fifteen percent'.

questions.q: What should listeners do before installation?
questions.explain: 'Before you begin installation, please turn off the power ... at the main circuit breaker'. Tải ứng dụng làm sau khi bật điện lại.

questions.q: What does the speaker say is available around the clock?
questions.explain: 'our support team is available twenty-four hours a day'.

audio.t: In local news, Millbrook's city council has approved a plan to upgrade the town's water treatment plant.
The project, which will cost twelve million dollars, is expected to begin in March and take about eighteen months.
Officials say the upgrade will improve water quality and reduce the risk of service interruptions during the summer.
To help pay for it, the average household will see a monthly increase of three dollars on their water bill starting next year.
A public meeting will be held next Tuesday at seven p.m. at the library, where residents can ask questions.
Now, on to the weather.

questions.q: What did the city council approve?
questions.explain: 'approved a plan to upgrade the town's water treatment plant'.

questions.q: According to the speaker, what will happen next year?
options: Residents will vote on a tax.
A new plant manager will start.
questions.explain: 'the average household will see a monthly increase of three dollars on their water bill starting next year'.

questions.q: Where will a public meeting be held?
questions.explain: 'A public meeting will be held next Tuesday ... at the library'.
